title: SecondBrain acquisition receipt v1
description: Six-field immutable receipt stored at receipts/v1/<id>.json. Status: DESIGN_REVIEW contract; no implementation is asserted.
$comment: Structural checks only. A conforming parser and semantic validator must additionally: (1) reject duplicate JSON keys, a BOM, NaN/Infinity and non-UTF-8 input before schema validation; (2) require the file name to equal '<id>.json' and the file to live under receipts/v1/; (3) require the id's hash8 to equal the first 8 characters of sha256; (4) require the id timestamp to be a valid UTC calendar date and time; (5) require the object objects/<sha256[0:2]>/<sha256> to exist and hash to sha256 (cross-link); (6) require collected_at to parse as a real zoned date-time (valid month/day/hour/offset). original_name is acquisition metadata preserved exactly as reported (Unicode kept raw, no NFC rewriting); it may contain characters unsafe as a file name and must NEVER be used as an output path. Working-copy and restore basenames are derived separately and must reject separators, control characters, Windows reserved device names, ':' alternate data streams and trailing dot or space. source_path is recorded context only and is never used as a restore or write path.

id.description: Lowercase acquisition id: cap-<yyyymmdd>t<hhmmss>z-<hash8>, optional collision suffix starting at -2 with no leading zeros.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex of the original bytes.

original_name.description: Name of the source as observed at capture, preserved exactly.

source_path.description: Source path as observed at capture. Metadata only.

collected_at.description: RFC 3339 local collection time; the pattern requires an explicit Z or numeric offset.

tool_version.description: Semantic version of the tool release that wrote the receipt, e.g. 0.0.1. Must match secondbrain.__version__ and build metadata at packaging time.
